item.description:

### [Join the Conversation](https://www.ncronline.org/join-conversation) Shortly after the release of Pope Leo XIV's landmark encyclical on artificial intelligence, _Magnifica Humanitas_, a leading AI expert expressed skepticism over the document's ability to effect concrete change around regulation of the tech industry.
Elham Tabassi, director of the Brookings Institution's Artificial Intelligence and Emerging Technology Initiative, [said](https://www.brookings.edu/articles/understanding-pope-leos-ai-encyclical/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) on the encyclical: "I don't think that this is going to be a driver for any sort of legislation or anything," though she maintained that the document could still influence important conversations around AI.

item.title: PartsSource Names Nick Marzotto to Lead Artificial Intelligence Strategy
item.description:
[![Nick Marzotto, Vice President of AI and Data at PartsSource, will lead the company’s artificial intelligence strategy and help accelerate investments in data, AI and enterprise healthcare technology. Marzotto joins PartsSource after 15 years at Epic Systems.](https://mmx.prnewswire.com/media/MS1977729/Nick-Marzotto.jpg?id=OA2918527&w=500)](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/partssource-names-nick-marzotto-to-lead-artificial-intelligence-strategy-302865394.html#)
Nick Marzotto, Vice President of AI and Data at PartsSource, will lead the company’s artificial intelligence strategy and help accelerate investments in data, AI and enterprise healthcare technology.
Marzotto comes to PartsSource after 15 years at Epic Systems, the leading electronic health record (EHR) company, where his leadership experience bridged artificial intelligence, clinical applications, product strategy and large-scale health system technology implementations.
As Epic's Vice President of Clinical Applications and Artificial Intelligence since 2020, Marzotto led enterprise initiatives to operationalize generative AI, bringing more than 50 product teams together around common approaches to AI development and adoption.

item.title: Worthware Systems International Inc. Announces CellSell® AI: Artificial Intelligence Integrated Directly into CellSell®
item.description:
# Worthware Systems International Inc. Announces CellSell® AI: Artificial Intelligence Integrated Directly into CellSell® CNW Group
**CellSell** **®** **AI represents the next evolution of CellSell** **®** **business intelligence—bringing AI to the data, not the data to AI.**
OTTAWA, ON, Sept. 1, 2026 /CNW/ -- Worthware Systems International Inc., developer of CellSell® ( [[https://www.cellsell.com](https://www.cellsell.com)](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4760511-1&h=1869600660&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cellsell.com%2F&a=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cellsell.com)), the ERP platform purpose-built for wireless and telecom retailers and carrier-authorized dealers, today announced CellSell® AI, a new capability that integrates artificial intelligence directly into the operational core of CellSell®.
[![CellSell® AI](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAAAAP///ywAAAAAAQABAAACAUwAOw==)](https://s.yimg.com/lo/mysterio/api/d1981aa3ae7f98453a00fcd57d8fc54481aa294a971023e32f1afb32faff61b2/lightyear_networkapi/resizefit_w960%3Bquality_80%3Bformat_webp/https%3A%2F%2Fmedia.zenfs.com%2Fen%2Fcnwgroup.com%2Fdd7a940b3d22c4b11e4d1e2e12a3aa87.jpg)
CellSell® AI
CellSell® AI enables retailers and carrier-authorized dealers to use **natural-language questions to analyze their business data directly within CellSell** **®** **—without exporting data to a separate AI application or workflow.** Authorized users can ask questions about sales, inventory, activations, accounting, and other business information using everyday language and receive AI-powered analysis directly within CellSell®.
This architecture allows AI-powered analysis to operate within CellSell®, where business logic, operational workflows, and financial controls already reside.
CellSell® AI supports Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) and Choose-Your-Own-Model (CYOM), giving businesses control over their account with a Worthware-supported AI provider and their preferred AI model without leaving CellSell®.
AI-powered analysis and decision support are delivered directly within CellSell®—without requiring businesses to extract data, build external AI pipelines, or move workflows to a separate AI platform.
**CellSell** **®** **AI is available now and is compatible with CellSell** **®** **Cloud, CellSell** **®** **Pro, and CellSell** **®** **HACI.**
CellSell® delivers unified POS, recurring billing, inventory, service and repair management, paperless e-contracts, direct carrier integration for activations, omni-channel inventory, accrual-based real-time integrated accounting, artificial intelligence (AI), and more—all consolidated within a single enterprise-grade system.
